profile_text.body:
Cerence Inc. is a public company headquartered in Burlington, Massachusetts, traded under the ticker CRNC, with SEC CIK 0001768267. On its own site the company describes itself as delivering conversational and agentic AI-powered user experiences for automotive and beyond, built on CaLLM, which it describes as its family of language models. It says it is moving to advance generative AI and LLM-powered innovation that it expects to be central to the automotive and transportation user experience, and it presents tailor-made AI solutions that integrate with vehicle makers' own brands.

Its named products include Cerence Emergency Vehicle Detection, or EVD, which the company says is already deployed in production vehicles and can detect and localize more than 1,500 emergency sirens across nearly 50 countries, from more than 300 meters away using interior microphones and beyond 800 meters with exterior microphones. The site also describes dynamic speech enhancement for multi-seat in-car environments, demonstrated by Timo Matheja and Stefan Hamerich, and work with Microsoft on Zero Trust and layered AI security for in-car assistants. In its third quarter results, the company reported revenue up 12% YoY and connected services revenue up 20% YoY, with operating cash flow of $20M supporting its first-ever share repurchase program.

The company's recorded legal exposure sits in Massachusetts, where 191 matters are counted.
